component.name: PkgView
component.summary: Browse and extract PS3/PSP .pkg installation packages

description.p: PkgView lists the contents of PS3 and PSP .pkg files (debug and retail) in a folder tree and decrypts and extracts selected files or folders. It also shows the package header, the PARAM.SFO title information and ICON0.PNG, and can check the package's SHA-1 digest.
Rust/GTK4 port of PkgView 1.3 (2010-2012) by Ifcaro.

description.p: First public release: new app ID (io.github.stolly345.pkgview), project homepage, screenshots.
GNOME Files integration: package icons as thumbnails, Extract Here / Extract To… / Open with PkgView in the right-click menu, and a progress-window-only extract mode. Man page and shell completions.

Browsing: sortable and optional columns, search with wildcards, path bar with back/forward/up, keyboard shortcuts, recent files and a welcome page, open files with their default application, drag files out, drop several packages or a folder to bulk-extract.
Internal restructuring and extraction options groundwork; checked against real packages.
Bulk extract: extract several packages into one folder.
